name: mizan-oscal
description: Mizan High-Assurance OSCAL v1.2.3 Compliance Kernel & Workbench — Universal Tool Calling Protocol (UTCP) Manual

info.description: Mizan High-Assurance OSCAL v1.2.3 Compliance Kernel & Workbench — Universal Tool Calling Protocol (UTCP) Manual
info.title: mizan-oscal

tools.name: query_control
tools.description: Query an OSCAL catalog for control text, parameters, and guidance (read-only)

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Inspect an OSCAL document summary, kinds, control counts, and metadata (read-only)

tools.name: compute_blast_radius
tools.description: Calculate the downstream compliance blast radius for a control or component (read-only)

tools.name: validate_fedramp
tools.description: Run high-assurance FedRAMP PMO baseline validation on an SSP (read-only)

tools.name: audit_kubernetes_cluster
tools.description: Audit live Kubernetes cluster or workload against NIST 800-53 controls and optionally write OSCAL assessment results (write)

output_file.description: Optional output path for OSCAL assessment-results.json

tools.name: evaluate_rego_policy
tools.description: Evaluate an input JSON artifact against compiled OSCAL Rego rules using Microsoft Regorus (read-only)

policy_file.description: Path to Rego policy file or directory

query_package.description: Rego query package (e.g. oscal.ac_2 or oscal.k8s)

tools.name: sync_3way_merge
tools.description: Perform 3-way GitOps AST merge across base, upstream, and local documents (transform)

tools.name: split_oscal_markdown
tools.description: Split a monolithic OSCAL document into an agile Markdown authoring workspace (write)

output_dir.description: Directory to populate with Markdown chapters

tools.name: assemble_oscal_markdown
tools.description: Assemble an agile Markdown authoring workspace back into a validated OSCAL document (write)

output_file.description: Output path for the assembled OSCAL document

tools.name: export_baseline_catalog
tools.description: Retrieve an embedded built-in tri-jurisdictional compliance catalog (read-only)

tools.name: extend_enterprise_catalog
tools.description: Build an enterprise custom compliance catalog inheriting base standards with custom controls and parameter overlays (transform)

tools.name: generate_slsa_provenance
tools.description: Generate a SLSA v1.2 / v1.0 supply chain provenance attestation statement with OSCAL evidence Merkle proof (write)

evidence_file.description: Optional path to evidence bundle JSON

tools.name: verify_slsa_provenance
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a SLSA v1.2 / v1.0 supply chain provenance statement (read-only)

statement_json.description: JSON string of the in-toto SLSA statement

tools.name: query_cas_store
tools.description: Query local Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) for object contents or stats (read-only)

tools.name: export_sarif
tools.description: Convert an OSCAL compliance document into an OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 report, optionally saving to disk (write)

output_file.description: Optional output path to save the SARIF report

tools.name: export_gitlab
tools.description: Convert an OSCAL compliance document into GitLab Security Scanner Report v15.0.0, optionally saving to disk (write)

output_file.description: Optional output path to save the GitLab report

tools.name: import_sbom_cyclonedx
tools.description: Convert CycloneDX v1.5/v1.6 or SPDX SBOM JSON into an OSCAL component-definition, optionally saving to disk (write)

file.description: Path to source SBOM JSON file

output_file.description: Optional output path to save the OSCAL component-definition

tools.name: evaluate_policy_rulepack
tools.description: Evaluate verified built-in Rego compliance rules (CIS K8s 5.2.1, 5.2.6, FedRAMP AC-2, CCCS ITSG-33) against workload JSON/YAML (read-only)

input_data.description: JSON string of Kubernetes/cloud workload resource

tools.name: execute_compliance_pipeline
tools.description: Execute full end-to-end compliance pipeline: Ingest SBOM -> Evaluate Policies -> OSCAL Assessment -> SLSA v1.2 Provenance -> SARIF & GitLab Export (write)

workload_file.description: Optional path to workload manifest JSON/YAML

tools.name: fabric_status
tools.description: Inspect Root Fabric status: active tenants, SPIFFE trust domain, and isolated DataStore partitions (read-only)

tools.name: fabric_validate_spiffe
tools.description: Validate a SPIFFE Workload Identity ID URI (spiffe://<trust-domain>/<path>) (read-only)

tools.name: ingest_security_report_to_poam
tools.description: Ingest a SARIF v2.1.0 or GitLab Security scan report and generate/update an OSCAL Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) with mapped controls (write)

existing_poam_file.description: Optional path to an existing POA&M document to append findings to

output_file.description: Optional output path to write the POA&M document

report_file.description: Path to SARIF or GitLab Security Report JSON

tools.name: export_utcp_manual
tools.description: Generate the Universal Tool Calling Protocol (UTCP v1.0.1) manual for Mizan across CLI, HTTP, gRPC, or MCP transports (read-only)

output_file.description: Optional workspace-confined output file path to write the UTCP manual JSON

tools.name: search_utcp_tools
tools.description: Search Mizan UTCP tools by keyword, tag, or description and inspect tool call templates (read-only)

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return

query.description: Search query matching tool name, tags, or description
